tts_summary: Welcome! I’m so glad you’re here for Max’s very first month. Since Max is an energetic 10-month-old Golden living in an apartment, this month is all about setting up his essentials and building a chicken-free nutrition and training routine. You’ll find carefully chosen food, treats, and apartment-friendly supplies—everything Max needs to thrive indoors. Explore your personalized plan below and see how perfectly it’s tailored for Max.
